question: To whom has the account concerning Ṣaṭmukha and his group been told?
premises: The recipients and subjects include you, Kāmeśī, and the group of Ṣaṭmukha
inference: The teaching about Ṣaṭmukha and his group has been communicated to Kāmeśī
plain_english: O Kāmeśī, this has been told to you concerning Ṣaṭmukha and his group.
